errors.backendUnreachable: The local WorkPilot backend did not answer. Start it (or restart the app), then refresh.

share.title: Share this session
share.masked: Secrets, tokens and your local folders are always masked before the file is written.

options.stripReasoningHint: Only the actions are shared: thinking steps and reasoning are left out.
options.stripTokensHint: Token counts and costs can hint at the model that was used.
options.includeFileContentsHint: Diff lines are always kept; whole files before and after are left out unless you include them.

video.hint: The video is the same masked page, played step by step in a headless browser on this machine. It lasts two minutes at most.
video.savedPart: Video saved to {{path}}: it plays {{played}} of {{total}} steps, the page shows them all.

refused.no_playwright: A video needs Playwright, which this machine's backend does not have. Install it with the backend's requirements, then try again.
refused.no_browser: A video needs Chromium or Chrome, and none was found on this machine. Install one (for instance with “playwright install chromium”), then try again.
refused.no_encoder: A video needs Playwright's video encoder, which is not installed. Run “playwright install ffmpeg”, then try again.
